11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager who is an excellent farmer has a secret: they want to learn to dance.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is an excellent farmer. Everyone says so. The harvests are reliable, the fields are well tended, and (subject.he/she) knows more about soil than most villagers know about their own relatives. But (subject) has a secret: (subject.he/she) wants to learn to dance.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: That evening (subject) dances between the rows of crops. The plants make an excellent audience. A passing villager hears the music of (subject.his/her) humming but sees nothing unusual.

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (friend) agrees enthusiastically. The first lesson is a disaster. (subject) steps on (friend)'s foot twice and nearly falls into a basket. By the end of the afternoon, however, (subject.he/she) has learned three steps and is eager to try again.
